title: Convergence of a couple
statement:
In the situation of [def-sp-exact-couple], regard all cycle and boundary
objects as subobjects of the initial page $E_2$. Set $Z_2=E_2$, $B_2=0$.
Given $E_r=Z_r/B_r$, define $Z_{r+1}\subseteq Z_r$ as the inverse image of
$\ker d_r$, and $B_{r+1}\subseteq Z_r$ as the inverse image of
$\operatorname{im}d_r$ under $Z_r\twoheadrightarrow E_r$, component by
component. Thus $E_{r+1}=Z_{r+1}/B_{r+1}$, the $Z_r$ decrease, and the $B_r$
increase inside $E_2$. When these limits exist, put
$Z_\infty=\bigcap_rZ_r$, $B_\infty=\bigcup_rB_r$, and
$E_\infty=Z_\infty/B_\infty$. The couple is *regular* if each
$Z_r^{p,q}\subseteq E_2^{p,q}$ is eventually constant. It is *complete* if
the subobjects $\operatorname{im}(\alpha^r:D^{p+r,q-r}\to D^{p,q})$ have zero
intersection for every $(p,q)$. It is *bounded* if, for every total degree
$n$, only finitely many pairs $(p,q)$ with $p+q=n$ satisfy $E_2^{p,q}\ne0$.
Assume that for every $n$ the colimit
$A^n:=\operatorname{colim}_{p\to-\infty}D^{p,n-p}$ along $\alpha$ exists in
$\mathcal A$. Define $F^pA^n$ to be the image of the canonical map
$D^{p,n-p}\to A^n$; since $D^{p+1,n-p-1}\to A^n$ factors through $\alpha$, one has
$F^{p+1}A^n\subseteq F^pA^n$, so this is a decreasing filtration in the sense of
[def-sp-filtration]. The exact-couple map $g:D^{p,q}\to E_2^{p,q}$ lands in
$Z_\infty^{p,q}$ and therefore gives a canonical map
$D^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}$. The filtration map gives a canonical map
$D^{p,q}\to\operatorname{gr}^pA^{p+q}$. The couple *weakly converges
to* the filtered objects $(A^n,F)$ if these two maps are both onto and have
the same kernel, so they induce canonical isomorphisms
$E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^pA^{p+q}$. It *abuts to* $(A,F)$ if it
weakly converges and $\bigcap_pF^pA^n=0$ and $\bigcup_pF^pA^n=A^n$ for
every $n$. It *converges to* $(A,F)$ if it is regular, abuts to $(A,F)$,
and $A^n\cong\varprojlim_p A^n/F^pA^n$ for every $n$ (the abutment);
these are the convergence conventions of Stacks Tag 012U.

proof.text: Construct the initial single-page presentation with Z = top, B = bottom and projection the top inclusion. Its epi property follows because the top inclusion is an isomorphism; its kernel and the bottom inclusion are zero by cancellation of that monomorphism. Recursively apply [lem-cycle-boundary-tower-step] to the preceding presentation. The one-step equations uniquely pin the successor subobjects, kernel lift and projection, so choice introduces no arbitrary data. Assemble the stages and their successor compatibility fields into CycleBoundaryTower by dependent natural-number recursion. The remaining one-step quotient construction is the only new sorry; this is a decomposition with net zero holes.

For limitBoundary_le_cycle, obtain monotonicity of B and antitonicity of Z from the successor inequalities of CycleBoundaryTower. For any indices s,r, B_s is contained in B_max(s,r), hence in Z_max(s,r), hence in Z_r. Apply the least-upper-bound property of the limiting boundaries, then the greatest-lower-bound property of the limiting cycles.

For g_factors_limitCycles, inductively construct a map a_r from D to Z_r whose composite with the inclusion is initialG and whose composite with the page projection and page f is zero. At r=0 this is f_g_zero from [def-sp-exact-couple], transported by eqToHom_naturality. Since d=f followed by g, the induction hypothesis factors a_r through the pullback of ker(d_r), and therefore factors initialG through Z_(r+1). Monicity of the Z_r inclusion identifies the composite of this new lift with ofLE with a_r. The equations projection_succ and cycleLift_comm, together with DerivedMaps.f_comm and monicity of derivedDInclusion, show that the new lift followed by the new page f is again zero. Thus image(initialG) is a lower bound of all Z_r; the GLB property puts it below the limiting cycles. This avoids the stronger formula Z_(r+2)=f inverse image of im(alpha^r).

For imageFiltration_antitone, the cocone equation identifies iota_(p+1) with alphaDiagonal followed by iota_p. Mathlib imageSubobject_comp_le gives the consecutive inclusion. Mathlib antitone_int_of_succ_le gives all integer-indexed inclusions, hence the decreasing filtration of [def-sp-filtration].

For weakConvergence_comparison, install the two epimorphism instances from weak convergence. Equal kernel subobjects imply that each kernel inclusion is killed by the other map, using kernelSubobject_factors_iff. Mathlib Abelian.epiDesc therefore constructs a map in each direction. Its factorization equation and cancellation of the epimorphisms show that the two composites are identities. The same cancellation proves uniqueness of the resulting isomorphism.

For filtrationStep_comp_quotient_zero, express the later filtration inclusion as Subobject.ofLE followed by the earlier inclusion, using antitone_step of [def-sp-filtration] and Subobject.ofLE_arrow. Associativity and cokernel.condition give zero.

split_report.summary: Repaired the abutment definition: the limit object is the alpha-colimit A^n, the filtration is its image filtration, and weak convergence, abutting, and convergence are stated with their separated, exhaustive, regularity, and inverse-limit clauses. Added the bounded terminology required by consumers. No child nodes are needed.
split_report.blueprint: The item realizes the blueprint definition through the Z_r/B_r recursion, regularity, completeness, boundedness, the alpha-colimit limit object and image filtration, and the weakly-convergent/abutting/convergent associated-graded comparison (Stacks Tags 011N, 012U).
